exams.name: Automating Cisco Enterprise Solutions (ENAUTO)
exams.blurb: CCNP Enterprise concentration exam on programming and automating Cisco enterprise networks with Python, REST APIs, Ansible and controller platforms.

exams.name: Cisco AI Technical Practitioner
exams.blurb: Cisco credential covering artificial intelligence fundamentals, data readiness, model deployment and AI infrastructure considerations for technical teams.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Design Expert
exams.blurb: Expert-level network design credential requiring a written exam plus an eight-hour scenario-based practical covering business-driven architecture decisions.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Automation
exams.blurb: Expert track, formerly branded DevNet Expert, combining the AUTOCOR written exam with a hands-on lab on network automation systems and platform APIs.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Collaboration
exams.blurb: Expert certification requiring the CLCOR written exam and an eight-hour lab on Cisco unified communications, video and Webex collaboration deployments.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Data Center
exams.blurb: Expert credential combining the DCCOR written exam with a lab on Nexus switching, ACI fabrics, UCS compute, storage networking and data centre automation.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Enterprise Infrastructure
exams.blurb: The best known Cisco expert track, pairing the ENCOR written exam with an eight-hour lab on enterprise routing, switching, SD-WAN and automation.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Enterprise Wireless
exams.blurb: Expert wireless track requiring the ENCOR written exam plus a lab covering wireless design, deployment, security and troubleshooting at enterprise scale.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Security
exams.blurb: Expert security credential requiring the SCOR written exam and a lab on firewalls, secure access, VPNs, identity services and network threat defence.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Service Provider
exams.blurb: Expert track for carrier networks, pairing the SPCOR written exam with a lab on MPLS, segment routing, BGP scale and service provider automation.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Network Associate
exams.blurb: Cisco associate networking certification covering IP connectivity, switching, wireless, security fundamentals and automation; refreshed with AI content in 2026.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Network Associate Automation
exams.blurb: Associate exam on APIs, Python, version control and infrastructure automation using Cisco platforms; previously branded Cisco Certified DevNet Associate.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Network Associate Cybersecurity
exams.blurb: Security operations centre associate exam on monitoring, intrusion analysis and incident handling, formerly branded Cisco Certified CyberOps Associate.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Network Professional Automation
exams.blurb: Professional track on designing and operating network automation systems, formerly the Cisco Certified DevNet Professional built around the DEVCOR core.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Network Professional Collaboration
exams.blurb: Professional certification requiring the CLCOR core exam plus a concentration on call control, hybrid cloud collaboration or cloud customer experience.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Network Professional Cybersecurity
exams.blurb: Professional security operations track, formerly CyberOps Professional, combining the CBRCOR core with forensics or threat hunting concentration exams.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Network Professional Data Center
exams.blurb: Professional track requiring the DCCOR core exam plus a concentration in data centre design, troubleshooting, ACI, storage networking or AI infrastructure.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Network Professional Enterprise
exams.blurb: Cisco professional certification earned by passing the ENCOR core exam plus one enterprise concentration such as ENARSI, ENSDWI, ENSLD or ENAUTO.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Network Professional Security
exams.blurb: Professional security certification requiring the SCOR core exam plus a concentration in firewall, identity services, email, web or VPN technologies.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Network Professional Service Provider
exams.blurb: Professional certification for carrier and ISP engineers, built on the SPCOR core exam plus a concentration in advanced routing, VPN services or automation.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Network Professional Wireless
exams.blurb: Professional wireless track relaunched by Cisco in 2026 around the WLCOR core exam, covering wireless design, deployment, security and assurance.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Support Technician Cybersecurity
exams.blurb: Entry-level Cisco credential covering security principles, network security concepts, endpoint protection, vulnerability assessment and incident handling.

exams.name: Cisco Certified Support Technician Networking
exams.blurb: Entry-level Cisco certification covering networking basics, addressing, cabling, endpoints, diagnostics and infrastructure for early-career technicians.

exams.name: Designing and Implementing Cloud Connectivity (ENCC)
exams.blurb: CCNP Enterprise concentration exam covering hybrid cloud connectivity, cloud-native routing, SD-WAN cloud onramp and secure interconnect design.

exams.name: Designing and Implementing Enterprise Network Assurance (ENNA)
exams.blurb: CCNP Enterprise concentration exam on network assurance, telemetry, ThousandEyes monitoring and data-driven troubleshooting of enterprise networks.

exams.name: Designing Cisco Enterprise Networks (ENSLD)
exams.blurb: CCNP Enterprise concentration exam on campus, WAN and services design methodology, including redundancy, addressing and SD-Access architecture.

exams.name: Implementing and Configuring Cisco Identity Services Engine (SISE)
exams.blurb: CCNP Security concentration exam covering Cisco ISE deployment, 802.1X authentication, profiling, guest access, BYOD and posture assessment.

exams.name: Implementing Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Solutions (ENSDWI)
exams.blurb: CCNP Enterprise concentration exam covering Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN architecture, controller deployment, policies, security and migration.

exams.name: Implementing Cisco Enterprise Advanced Routing and Services (ENARSI)
exams.blurb: The most popular CCNP Enterprise concentration exam, covering advanced BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VRF, MPLS and infrastructure services troubleshooting.

exams.name: Implementing Secure Solutions with Virtual Private Networks (SVPN)
exams.blurb: CCNP Security concentration exam covering site-to-site and remote-access VPN design with IPsec, DMVPN, FlexVPN and secure remote connectivity.

exams.name: Securing Networks with Cisco Firepower (SNCF)
exams.blurb: CCNP Security concentration exam on Cisco Secure Firewall and Firepower deployment, policy configuration, intrusion prevention and malware defence.
